hens_rule_text: up to 24 hens on lots of one acre or less; no hen limit on lots over one acre
permit_notes: No permit required for backyard chickens under the 2017 ordinance, per the city's announcement as reported in search extracts.
setback_notes: Coop or enclosure may not be within 25 feet of any building used for human occupancy. The extract does not say whether the owner's own home is excluded.
coop_rules: Structure with three or more sides and a roof, at least one square foot of roosting area per chicken.
zoning_notes: One rooster allowed only with at least six hens on lots of one acre or less; on larger lots, one rooster per six hens.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
code_section: Ch. 6, Art. VII (Livestock, Domestic Fowl and Bees)
